NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY.description: PRIMARY: NVIDIA NIM key (build.nvidia.com -> Get API Key). Auto-configures Hermes' native nvidia provider with z-ai/glm-5.3 via https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1. A secret named NVIDIA_API_KEY or NIM_API_KEY works too.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Starts the Hermes gateway automatically so you chat with Hermes on Telegram.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Chat id(s) allowed to command the bot, comma-separated (alias TELEGRAM_CLIENT_ID also works). Send /start to the bot to learn your id.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional fallback provider: Google AI Studio key (aistudio.google.com/apikey)

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional (never the default): OpenRouter key. Use with HERMES_PROVIDER=openrouter or HERMES_FALLBACK_PROVIDER=openrouter

AI_API_KEY.description: Optional: generic key for openai/anthropic/glm/custom providers

CUSTOM_BASE_URL.description: Optional: base URL of any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint (used with CUSTOM_API_KEY)

CUSTOM_API_KEY.description: Optional: key for the CUSTOM_BASE_URL endpoint

WEBSITE_CREDENTIALS.description: Optional: credentials for the authorized target website (JSON)
